title: Webhooks
intro: Send a signed HTTP POST to your services when something happens on the site. Failed deliveries are retried with backoff.
empty: No webhooks yet. Add an endpoint to receive site events.
name: Name
secret_help: Copy the signing secret now; it is not shown again. Use it to verify the X-GoRun-Signature header.
no_deliveries: No deliveries yet. Send a test to check the endpoint.
test_inactive: Enable the webhook before sending a test.
rotate_confirm: Replace the signing secret? Receivers must switch to the new one.
auto_disabled: Disabled after %d failed deliveries in a row. Fix the endpoint, then enable it.
verify_help: Every request carries X-GoRun-Event, X-GoRun-Delivery, X-GoRun-Timestamp and X-GoRun-Signature.
error.name: Enter a name (up to 100 characters).
error.url: Enter a valid URL without credentials or fragment.
error.events: Choose at least one known event.
